## Requirements without listed tests

Verified by means other than testing — or the check has not been set up yet.

- **FR-ARCH-160** (`implemented`, method `I`) — What carries a file is read before the file is changed
- **FR-CI-020** (`implemented`, method `I`) — The same gate runs before a commit
- **FR-CI-030** (`implemented`, method `I`) — The local self-test runs the real pipeline
- **FR-CI-040** (`implemented`, method `I`) — The rendered specification is published from the default branch
- **FR-CI-060** (`implemented`, method `I`) — The example project is checked as a downstream consumer
- **FR-CI-110** (`implemented`, method `I`) — The graph image is published beside the page
- **FR-DOC-010** (`implemented`, method `I`) — The landing page consists of eleven sections, in the order a reader's questions arise
- **FR-DOC-030** (`implemented`, method `I`) — The opening says what the framework is, for whom, and what it costs
- **FR-DOC-040** (`implemented`, method `I`) — The problem section names what agents broke and what a lookup repairs
- **FR-DOC-050** (`implemented`, method `I`) — The requirement section shows the block and says what the tooling makes of it
- **FR-DOC-060** (`implemented`, method `I`) — The benefits section names a capability per entry, and each is a requirement's
- **FR-DOC-070** (`implemented`, method `I`) — The grounds section says what the register and the layer add, and when not to keep one
- **FR-DOC-080** (`implemented`, method `I`) — The install section carries the commands and says what the installer asks and refuses
- **FR-DOC-090** (`implemented`, method `I`) — The agent section carries the entry point, the exit codes and the two decisions
- **FR-DOC-100** (`implemented`, method `I`) — The skills table names every procedure a project receives, and the rules that bind them
